# assignment precedence and right associativity

a = b + c * d;
a = b = c;
a += b *= c;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    Identifier, AssignOp,
    BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp,
      BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier)))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    Identifier, AssignOp,
    AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    Identifier, AssignOp,
    AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier))))


# parenthesized assignment targets

(a) = b;
((a)) += b;
(a.b) = c;
(a[b]) = c;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier), AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ParenthesizedExpression(ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier)),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ParenthesizedExpression(FieldAccess(Identifier, Identifier)),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ParenthesizedExpression(ArrayAccess(Identifier, Identifier)),
    AssignOp, Identifier)))


# field and array targets with parenthesized receivers

(a).b = c;
(a)[b] = c;
(a = b).c = d;
(a = b)[c] = d;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    FieldAccess(ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier), Identifier),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ArrayAccess(ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier), Identifier),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    FieldAccess(ParenthesizedExpression(
      AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)), Identifier),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ArrayAccess(ParenthesizedExpression(
      AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)), Identifier),
    AssignOp, Identifier)))


# parenthesized operands in initializers

int c = a + (b = 3);
int d = (a) + b;
int e = ((a + b));

==>

Program(
  LocalVariableDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(
    Definition, AssignOp,
    BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp,
      ParenthesizedExpression(AssignmentExpression(
        Identifier, AssignOp, IntegerLiteral))))),
  LocalVariableDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(
    Definition, AssignOp,
    BinaryExpression(ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier), ArithOp, Identifier))),
  LocalVariableDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(
    Definition, AssignOp,
    ParenthesizedExpression(ParenthesizedExpression(
      BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier))))))


# assignments in full expression contexts

set(a = b);
a[b = c] = d;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(MethodInvocation(MethodName(Identifier),
    ArgumentList(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ArrayAccess(Identifier, AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)),
    AssignOp, Identifier)))


# assignments in conditional operands

x = cond ? a = b : c;
x = cond ? a : (b = c);

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    TernaryExpression(Identifier, LogicOp,
      AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier), Identifier))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    TernaryExpression(Identifier, LogicOp, Identifier,
      ParenthesizedExpression(AssignmentExpression(
        Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier))))))


# lambdas in conditional and cast expressions

f = cond ? x -> x : y -> y;
f = (Function) x -> x;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    TernaryExpression(Identifier, LogicOp,
      LambdaExpression(Definition, Identifier),
      LambdaExpression(Definition, Identifier)))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    CastExpression(TypeName, LambdaExpression(Definition, Identifier)))))


# parenthesized assignments in unary operands

x = (int) -(a = b);
x = -(a = b);
x = (a)++;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    CastExpression(PrimitiveType,
      UnaryExpression(ArithOp, ParenthesizedExpression(
        AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)))))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    UnaryExpression(ArithOp, ParenthesizedExpression(
      AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier))))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    UpdateExpression(ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier), UpdateOp))))


# tolerant binary assignment left operands

a + b = 3;
int c = a + b = 3;
a + b += c * d;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier), AssignOp, IntegerLiteral)),
  LocalVariableDeclaration(PrimitiveType, VariableDeclarator(
    Definition, AssignOp, AssignmentExpression(
      BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier), AssignOp, IntegerLiteral))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier), AssignOp,
    BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier))))


# tolerant unary cast and update assignment left operands

-a = b;
(int) a = b;
a++ = b;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    UnaryExpression(ArithOp, Identifier), AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    CastExpression(PrimitiveType, Identifier), AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    UpdateExpression(Identifier, UpdateOp), AssignOp, Identifier)))


# tolerant conditional parenthesized and call assignment left operands

cond ? a : b = c;
(a + b) = c;
call() = b;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    TernaryExpression(Identifier, LogicOp, Identifier, Identifier),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    ParenthesizedExpression(BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier)),
    AssignOp, Identifier)),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
    MethodInvocation(MethodName(Identifier), ArgumentList), AssignOp, Identifier)))


# assignments in lambda bodies

f = x -> x = y;
f = () -> a = b;
f = cond ? x -> x = y : z -> z = y;

==>

Program(
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    LambdaExpression(Definition, AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    LambdaExpression(FormalParameters, AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)))),
  ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
    TernaryExpression(Identifier, LogicOp,
      LambdaExpression(Definition, AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier)),
      LambdaExpression(Definition, AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, Identifier))))))


# recover an incomplete binary assignment inside a method

class C { void m() { a + b = ; } }

==>

Program(ClassDeclaration(class, Definition, ClassBody(
  MethodDeclaration(void, Definition, FormalParameters, Block(
    ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
      BinaryExpression(Identifier, ArithOp, Identifier), AssignOp, ⚠)))))))


# recover an incomplete parenthesized assignment inside a method

class C { void m() { (a) = ; } }

==>

Program(ClassDeclaration(class, Definition, ClassBody(
  MethodDeclaration(void, Definition, FormalParameters, Block(
    ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(
      ParenthesizedExpression(Identifier), AssignOp, ⚠)))))))


# recover an incomplete compound assignment inside a method

class C { void m() { a += ; } }

==>

Program(ClassDeclaration(class, Definition, ClassBody(
  MethodDeclaration(void, Definition, FormalParameters, Block(
    ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp, ⚠)))))))


# recover an incomplete conditional assignment inside a method

class C { void m() { x = cond ? y : ; } }

==>

Program(ClassDeclaration(class, Definition, ClassBody(
  MethodDeclaration(void, Definition, FormalParameters, Block(
    ExpressionStatement(AssignmentExpression(Identifier, AssignOp,
      TernaryExpression(Identifier, LogicOp, Identifier, ⚠))))))))
